mapper.select: /* org.mtf.sok.mapper.SnsMapper.selectBlogList */ SELECT b.reg_dt , b.seq , b.link_url , b.title , b.file_name FROM blog b WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT b2.* FROM blog b2 WHERE b2.link_url = b.link_url AND b.reg_dt < b2.reg_dt) ORDER BY b.reg_dt DESC, b.seq LIMIT 9

/* org.mtf.sok.mapper.SnsMapper.selectInstagramList */ SELECT i.reg_dt , i.seq , i.link_url , i.title , i.description , i.file_name FROM instagram i WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT i2.* FROM instagram i2 WHERE i2.link_url = i.link_url AND i.reg_dt < i2.reg_dt) ORDER BY i.reg_dt DESC, i.seq LIMIT 9
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO blog (seq, link_url, title, image_src, file_name, reg_dt) VALUES
(#{item.seq}, #{item.linkUrl}, #{item.title}, #{item.imageSrc}, #{item.fileName}, #{item.regDt})

INSERT INTO instagram (seq, title, description, link_url, image_src, file_name, reg_dt) VALUES
(#{item.seq}, #{item.title}, #{item.description}, #{item.linkUrl}, #{item.imageSrc}, #{item.fileName}, #{item.regDt})
mapper.update: UPDATE insta SET token = #{token}, final_regi_pic = 'SYSTEM', final_regi_dttm = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT seq , token , init_regi_dttm as initRegiDttm , final_regi_dttm as finalRegiDttm FROM insta LIMIT 1
